triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: B-2861 is acceptable when the target document and final response include an evidence-backed optimization table, and checklist evidence shows the 3x2 review, reconciliation ledger, and document optimizations were completed without code-scope expansion.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the user-requested document review outcome to the complete checklist chain: evidence pack, 3x2 review, reconciliation, approved document edits, and DONE optimization table.

note: ProofStory contract for a documentation-only 3x2 review story. No runtime or CLI code implementation is in scope.
